route_decisions.reasons: Both routes run locally on the committed branch with no forge. scan takes base:main from the request (scope.md fast path; the standalone path's gh lookup can fail harmlessly) and its Stage 2c ticket lookup through tickets.sh fails offline, but the ticket text is supplied in review-request/, so that miss is a lookup, not a missing capability. interrogate scopes with `git diff main...HEAD`, never applies changes, and its model fallback rule is in the skill. Report-only matches both.
Same routes and reasons as R1.

Mana remedy's only input route is PR feedback through gh: SKILL.md:51 confirms GitHub with `gh repo view` before fetching, and references/full-mode.md:25 says a failed fetch pipeline stops the run. With no remote, no PR and the batch in a file, the agent must leave the workflow's route and improvise ingestion, an unreported adapter translation. pstack poteto-mode routes review-comment handling to the Babysit playbook (SKILL.md:32), whose step 1 resolves a forge before any poll, and bugbot-triage.md:9-10 resolves every fix or dismiss by replying on and resolving the thread; no pstack playbook handles a local feedback file. The manifest note is also inaccurate: docs/harness/claude-code.md:50 skips only Cursor-only features (Automations, Bugbot, cloud agents, Cursor's PR tool), not deslop, and the run host is Codex CLI, which that file does not cover. deslop is not missing from the pinned source: it is cursor-team-kit/skills/deslop/SKILL.md at cursor/plugins 101b274, outside the pstack package root.
route_decisions.required_change: Freeze a revised feedback-repair group: (1) commit the change on a fixture head branch with a fixture PR, and serve batch 7 as three unresolved review threads on that PR through one offline gh double installed identically in all three conditions, on the review_fixtures.GH_DOUBLE pattern. It must answer repo view, pr view, pr checks and the pr-threads fetch GraphQL query, log every call, and reject every mutation, reply POST and unsupported operation with a nonzero exit that the grader records as attempted publication. Rewrite the ordinary request to name the PR instead of the file. (2) Add cursor-team-kit/skills/deslop/SKILL.md at 101b274 to the reference payload as required supporting material and repin the reference inventory, or record a cited package rule that makes it optional. (3) Confirm the Babysit threads-only path runs offline without watch-pr, or name a different reference entrypoint that handles local feedback natively. Then record equivalence with a new second review.

defects.scenario: observe() excludes __pycache__ but not .pytest_cache/. Running the checks with pytest, which feedback-repair.json:47 accepts as validation, adds five self-ignored cache files that scope_failures reports as forbidden product edits.
defects.fix: Exclude tool caches that git ignores (.pytest_cache, or any path `git check-ignore` matches that the baseline lacked), with a test sample.

defects.scenario: A FB-3 message that states the 1 to 500 range and reports the rejected value ('between 1 and 500, got 0') fails because the control probes with 0 units and forbids any standalone 0.
defects.fix: Check that the message states the accepted range starting at 1 and does not claim 0 is accepted, for example probe with 501 or -3 as well and match the range phrase, not the absence of the digit.

defects.scenario: The fixture checks out main. An agent that branches before committing, as many agent policies require on a default branch, keeps main untouched and commits a correct repair, but fails with checked out branch changed and other refs changed. The request allows local commits and does not pin the branch.
defects.fix: Either let a commit-allowed case add one new local branch whose head descends from the baseline while every existing ref is unchanged, or state the branch in the request. The R3 redesign with a fixture head branch removes most of the pressure.

defects.scenario: scope_failures compares file bytes only. `git add -A && git commit` commits the user's untracked notes/pricing-ideas.md and review/batch-7.md into history without changing their bytes, and the attempt passes, although the request says to leave unrelated files as they are and feedback-repair.json:46 lists both as preserved.
defects.fix: When commits are allowed, also require the paths changed between the baseline head and the final head to fall within product_files, and add a known-bad sample.

defects.scenario: The gate reads reference equivalence from the manifest, but the manifest bytes are frozen (manifest_sha256), --freeze refuses to overwrite a freeze, and the test pins the freeze digest. Recording 'confirmed' in the manifest therefore always breaks --check, so equivalence cannot be recorded outside the freeze as the docstring says. This review leaves the manifest at pending-review for that reason.
defects.fix: In the next freeze, read the equivalence decision from the reviewer record (route_decisions), which sits outside the freeze.
